body: **Describe the bug:** Subject: Edge Gallery v1.0.22 — conversation creation fails on OPPO Find N6 Hello Google AI Edge Gallery team, I am experiencing a persistent issue with Edge Gallery v1.0.22 on my OPPO Find N6 (16 GB RAM). When I try to create a conversation using Gemma-3n-E4B-it, I get this error: “Failed to create conversation: INTERNAL: ERROR ... Some ops are not accelerated. Add kLiteRtHwAcceleratorCpu to the compilation accelerator set to allow using the CPU to run those.” The same error occurs with a smaller model. The settings button in the upper-right corner is also unresponsive, so I cannot change the accelerator configuration. I have already force-stopped the app, cleared its cache, uninstalled and reinstalled it, and downloaded the models again. None of these steps resolved the issue. Could you please advise whether this is a known LiteRT runtime or accelerator compatibility issue, and how I can switch to a supported CPU/GPU configuration? Device: OPPO Find N6, 16 GB RAM App version: 1.0.22 Affected feature: AI Chat / Ask Image Thank you. **To Reproduce:** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Go to '...' 2. Click on '....' 3. labels.name: type:bug

body:
Title: Enable Thinking toggle resets after closing settings

Device: Google Pixel 9a
App version: 1.0.21
Model: Gemma-4-E2B-it

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open AI Chat and Configure settings.
2. Enable "Enable thinking".
3. Close settings using the X button.
4. Reopen Model configs.

Actual result:
"Enable thinking" is disabled again.

Expected result:
The setting should remain enabled.
